你先被一个地方的氛围和画面吸引。: A place first draws you in through its atmosphere and appearance.
你愿意为有趣的小故事停下，不必每站都读得很深。: You enjoy pausing for a good little story, without needing a deep dive at every stop.
你喜欢沿人物与作品的线索，读懂一个地方。: You like understanding places through the people and works connected to them.
你喜欢随心走，给偶遇留出空间。: You like following your curiosity and leaving room for chance encounters.
有大致方向就够了，途中仍可以改变主意。: A rough direction is enough, with room to change your mind along the way.
明确的站序与节奏，让你更安心地探索。: A clear order of stops and pace helps you explore with ease.
你享受安静独行，按自己的节奏观察。: You enjoy quiet solo time, observing at your own pace.
你更喜欢和一两个熟人分享沿途见闻。: You prefer sharing your discoveries with one or two close friends.
和大家边走边聊，会让旅途更有趣。: Walking and chatting with a group makes the journey more fun.
你优先选择不花钱也能享受的体验。: You look first for experiences you can enjoy for free.
你愿意为值得的体验付费，再按兴趣做选择。: You are happy to pay for worthwhile experiences, choosing what interests you.
你愿意花钱换取喜欢的体验。: You are happy to spend on experiences you enjoy.
从拱廊、收藏与酒店中的人物故事深入阅读；章节可自由挑选，下午茶或入馆体验按兴趣另: Read deeper into the people behind arcades, collections and hotels. Choose chapters freely, adding afternoon tea or museum visits if you wish.
用餐桌、名店与社交轶事串起清楚的章节，适合结伴阅读；挑一家安排用餐，其他地点可以: Clear chapters connect tables, famous restaurants and social anecdotes, ideal for sharing. Choose one place for a meal and enjoy the stories of the others.
从泳池、书店到屋顶，用清楚的章节安排独处时间；可只选两三处，泳池、游船与馆内体验: Give your solo time a clear sequence, from a pool and bookshop to a rooftop. Pick just two or three stops, adding swims, cruises or museum visits as you wish.
沿旧铁路、公园与水岸独立观察，章节给出探索方向；跨区路段可拆开，仅进入合法开放的: Explore old railways, parks and waterfronts at your own pace, guided by story chapters. Split up distant sections and use only areas legally open to visitors.
市集、河畔与餐桌的轻文化故事，适合同行分享；按片区挑一处相聚，消费、演出与城外行: Light cultural stories of markets, riversides and dining tables are made for sharing. Pick a place to meet, then choose any meals, shows or trips outside the city separately.
围绕能坐下来、慢慢读的巴黎地点展开，每次选一两处即可；不要求赶路，入馆、泳池或茶: Find Paris places where you can sit and read slowly. Choose one or two without rushing, adding museum visits, a swim or refreshments if you wish.
街角奇闻适合短读与随心发现；八个故事按片区自由挑选，读到喜欢的地方就可以停下。: Short street-corner curiosities suit spontaneous discovery. Choose among eight stories by neighborhood and stop whenever you find a place you like.
不强制站序，按片区从八个故事中就近挑选；用时随选择的地点和停留而定。: No fixed order: choose nearby chapters from the eight stories. Allow time according to your chosen places and stops.
四个选择，发现你的巴黎: Four choices. Your kind of Paris.
在地图上开启这条故事线: Start this story on the map
选最像你的那一个。最后一题后，故事线会为你展开。: Choose what feels most like you. Your story unfolds after the last answer.
四道题，找到适合你的故事线: Four questions to find your Paris story
从旅行偏好出发，看看你的巴黎旅行人格。: Discover your Paris travel personality through the things you enjoy.
也可以直接选一个旅行人格，进入对应的故事线。: You can also choose a travel personality and open its storyline directly.
看到一个地方，你最想知道的是——: At a new spot, the first thing you want to know is —
这儿好不好拍、氛围如何: Is it photogenic? What’s the vibe?
谁在这儿待过、哪本书哪部电影写过它: Who lived here, which book or film featured it
出发前你的行程是——: Before you set out, your itinerary is —
精确到站序和时段: Down to the stop order and time slots
理想的逛法是——: Your ideal way to explore is —
和一两个熟人: With one or two close friends
能免费看就绝不花钱: If it’s free to see, I won’t pay
花钱买体验，天经地义: Paying for experience is only natural
你负责享受，剩下的交给我。: You enjoy; I’ll handle the rest.
你是那种把所有人的行程都安排明白、还能顺便订到最难订的位子的人。文化、效率、社交: You’re the one who nails everyone’s itinerary and still lands the hardest reservation. Culture, efficiency, socializing, experience — you want it all, and you get it.
跟着我走，一分钱不多花。: Follow me — not a euro wasted.
你是朋友圈里那个「知道最多冷知识又最会省钱」的团长，路线排得明明白白，还专挑有梗: You’re the group leader who knows the most trivia and spends the least — tight routes, all the free-and-fun spots.
你享受独自的深度体验，愿意为品质买单，但不需要人陪。安静、考究、有内容，是你的关: You savor deep solo experiences and pay for quality, no company needed. Quiet, refined, substantial.
你对典故、人物关系、文本互文有近乎偏执的兴趣，喜欢按图索骥地走一条有纵深的线，独: You’re near-obsessive about allusions, relationships and textual echoes; you love walking a route with real depth — solo, thrifty, and happiest the deeper it goes.
有意思就上，别问计划。: If it’s cool, we’re in — don’t ask for a plan.
你有文化底子但讨厌被行程绑住，走到哪玩到哪，爱热闹也舍得花，蒙马特画家们的即兴人: Cultured but allergic to fixed schedules; you go where the fun is, love a crowd and don’t mind spending. The improvised life of the Montmartre painters is you.
你迷恋旧日故事和穷艺术家的浪漫，喜欢跟人聊天听掌故，钱不多但过得有滋味，海明威的: You love old stories and the romance of the broke artist; you chat, collect anecdotes, and live richly on little. Hemingway’s Paris is yours.
你偏爱安静而高级的文化体验，随性但讲究，愿意为一杯好茶、一间私人美术馆停下脚步。: You favor quiet, high-end culture — casual yet discerning, happy to stop for a fine tea or a private gallery.
和名人们，静静待一会儿。: A quiet while among the famous dead.
你喜欢清晨的公墓、无人的小美术馆，一个人安静地与历史相处，不赶时间也不花钱。: You like dawn cemeteries and empty little museums — communing quietly with history, unhurried and unspending.
你不太在乎典故，但极其在乎体验和排面，计划周密、出手大方，米其林和游船晚宴是你的: You don’t care much for allusions but care intensely about experience and status — well-planned, generous, at home with Michelin and dinner cruises.
你追求高效的打卡体验，路线安排得像时刻表，爱和人一起拍照发图，但不为深度内容停留: You chase efficient check-ins, routes tight as a timetable — you love group photos, but won’t linger for deep content.
你享受精心安排的独处，愿意为舒适买单，一个人沿河慢走、找家精品酒店喝下午茶，谁也: You enjoy carefully arranged solitude and pay for comfort — a slow riverside walk, afternoon tea at a boutique hotel, nobody bothering you.
往城市边缘走。: Head for the edge of the city.
你规划清楚但不爱人多，喜欢沿运河、去城市远端的公园，找免费的观景点，一个人吹风。: You plan clearly but avoid crowds — canal towpaths, far-flung parks, free viewpoints, wind in your face, alone.
你随性、爱热闹、出手阔绰，最开心的事是招呼一桌人吃吃喝喝，气氛比景点重要。: Spontaneous, sociable and generous — your favorite thing is treating a table of friends; atmosphere beats sightseeing.
你走到哪聊到哪，不做攻略也不花大钱，蒙马特街头的十五分钟人生，就是你的日常。: You chat everywhere, skip the planning and the big spending — the fifteen-minute street life of Montmartre is your everyday.
找个位子，坐一下午。: Find a seat, stay all afternoon.
你来巴黎就是为了躺平，公园草坪、露天咖啡、酒店大堂酒廊，舒服最重要，没人赶你就赢: You came to Paris to do nothing — park lawns, terrace cafés, hotel lounges. Comfort is everything; if nobody rushes you, you win.
你没有计划也不想有，一个人随机在街区里游荡，跳蚤市场、街头装置、小众甜品店，惊喜: No plan and no wish for one — you drift solo through neighborhoods; flea markets, street installations, obscure pâtisseries. Surprise beats destination.
